note: Hand-written driving tours for the web atlas. Each stop is a site id from atlas.json, in driving order. Tests check that every id exists.

tours.title: New Albany & the Falls
tours.summary: Steamboats, a Victorian mansion, the Underground Railroad church and the fossil beds at the Falls of the Ohio, along the riverfront from New Albany to Jeffersonville.

tours.title: The Knobs & the Rail Tunnels
tours.summary: Up from the river into the Knobstone hills: the Monon line, the old poor farm, the Buffalo Trace, Duncan Tunnel and the small towns of western Floyd County.

tours.title: Cave Country
tours.summary: Limestone karst from the Ohio River north: Squire Boone's cave, Wyandotte and Marengo, the Lost River, Spring Mill and Bluespring Caverns.

tours.title: First Capital & the Road to Freedom
tours.summary: Indiana's first state capitol and its only Civil War battlefield, a pioneer mill, then the Underground Railroad at Salem and Eleutherian College, ending at Madison's steep rail incline.

tours.title: Ohio River Road West
tours.summary: Downriver along the Ohio: a steamboat disaster, old river courthouses and mills, the Swiss town of Tell City, St. Meinrad, Evansville's wartime factories and utopian New Harmony.
